summary: Two US government systems report break-ins this week. The USDA confirmed a cyber threat that hit farm payment systems. The FBI is also probing a suspected breach of its crime database, per news reports. Stocks and Bitcoin fell sharply, with reports blaming AI worries.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: The FBI is looking into a suspected break-in at the NCIC, which police use to check warrants and records. It is unknown whether the database is down or whether data was taken.
events.stated_cause: Nobody has said who did it or how. The FBI had not made a public statement as of Friday night. Reports rely on two unnamed people briefed on the matter.

events.title: USDA cyber incident disrupts farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm payment, loan, mapping and contracting systems went offline for days. A USDA official said most systems should return Friday or over the weekend and that no personal data was lost.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat. NBC reports hackers got into the payment system, citing sources. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: US stocks close sharply lower Friday; Dow and S&P 500 in correction
events.impact: Friday close: Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.28%), S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.93%). The Dow fell 8% on the week, its worst since March 2020. The VIX fear gauge hit 39.53. I saw no reports of trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite worries about AI spending and chip stocks, with Nvidia down 14%. No technical fault or attack is reported. CNBC, NBC and Yahoo price data match.

events.title: Bitcoin falls to about 58K USD, down about 14% on the week
events.impact: CoinGecko shows about 57,947 (-6% in 24h, -14% in 7 days), with Coinbase Exchange at about 57,997. Coinglass showed 61,781 earlier Friday, so the drop deepened later in the day. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. The drop moves with the stock selloff. Fear index read extreme fear at 11 earlier.

events.title: Officials say earlier US outages had ordinary causes; cyber director stepping down
events.impact: Officials said the Microsoft, FAA and NSA outages had separate causes. NSA's network is reported back up. National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving. Some experts doubt it is all coincidence.
events.stated_cause: Microsoft cited an old software defect. The FAA cited a new router. The NSA cited maintenance. The intelligence director cited patching. No official source reports a cyber attack on those.

events.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard customer data leaked via outside providers
events.impact: Thousands of customer names and emails were reported leaked. Payments were not reported disrupted.
events.stated_cause: Hackers hit outside service providers. A Chase spokesperson says this is not related to its earlier outage this week.

events.title: Iran and US trade strikes around Bahrain, Kuwait and Hormuz
events.impact: Iran hit US sites in Bahrain and a Kuwait air base. The US struck a missile site on Qeshm Island Tuesday. CENTCOM denied a new strike Friday. Reports differ on new US strikes; Trump says he is not rushing.
events.stated_cause: Iran says it answers US drone flights and strikes on its towers. The US calls its strikes defensive. Talks are stalled.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Affects SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. Federal agencies must fix them. This is a routine-type notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA says it has evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker.

events.title: Undersea cable fault slows internet in Pakistan
events.impact: Pakistan's telecom authority reported a SEA-ME-WE 5 fault offshore, with slow service. I found no new update in this run.
events.stated_cause: Cause unknown and under investigation. Sabotage claims on social media are unverified.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Status feed shows Cloudflare Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 07:44 UTC Nov 21. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The USDA says a cyberthreat forced its shutdowns, and the FBI is checking a suspected breach. Nobody has named a culprit for either, and no official source links them. The earlier Microsoft, FAA and NSA outages were blamed on a software defect, a new router and maintenance. Stocks are blamed on AI worries.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement naming the same attacker or company behind the USDA and FBI break-ins, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: New FBI report rests on unnamed sources and the FBI has not commented. No official link between incidents.

prep_note: No action needed beyond normal care. Farmers should check the USDA site before relying on payment portals this weekend. Keep some cash and a backup payment card on hand. Use strong passwords and watch for scam emails that mention these breaches.
